The '''Venom Guard''' was an elite unit within [[Imperial Naval Special Forces|special forces]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Stock Ships" />

==History==
Venom Guard, a military unit of the [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Forces]] from the [[Imperial Naval Special Forces]], was contacted by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sakai]] of [[Thuris sector/Legends|Thuris sector]] once he had discovered the names of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents that were importuning him. The Guard then began to chase those Rebels, members of the elite unit [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]].<ref name="Stock Ships" />
